functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.course_entry_review_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status in ('rejected', 'more_evidence', 'returned_layer2', 'returned_layer3', 'superseded') then
    perform security.course_entry_review_apply_v1(new.id, new.status, null, 'Layer 4 ' || new.status);
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.entry_matrix_review_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status in ('rejected', 'more_evidence', 'returned_layer2', 'returned_layer3', 'superseded') then
    perform security.entry_matrix_review_apply_v1(new.id, new.status, null, 'Layer 4 ' || new.status);
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.field_enrich_items_absence_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.course_id is null or new.state is not distinct from old.state then return null; end if;
  if new.state in ('filled', 'review', 'skipped', 'failed') then perform security.field_absence_classify_v1(new.id); end if;
  return null;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.field_enrich_items_gate_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.course_id is null then return new; end if;
  -- held, or tried on the same input less than gaps.recheck_days ago: not queued (CF-247 21 Oct 2026: the hold is security.enrich_item_held_v1)
  if security.enrich_item_held_v1(new.course_id, new.field) then return null; end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.layer4_evidence_link_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
-- Trigger layer4_review_items_zz_evidence (BEFORE INSERT): a new waiting item of a kind in layer4.evidence_link_kinds that arrives without a
-- stored copy gets the newest stored copy of its page. No read is made; nothing else changes.
begin
  if new.evidence_id is null and new.status = 'pending' and security.pipeline_num_v1('layer4.evidence_link_on', 1) >= 1
     and new.field_code = any (security.pipeline_list_v1('layer4.evidence_link_kinds', '[]'::jsonb)) then
    new.evidence_id := security.layer4_stored_copy_v1(security.layer4_item_page_v1(new.field_code, new.proposed_value, new.layer2_state));
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.no_page_review_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status in ('rejected', 'more_evidence', 'returned_layer2', 'returned_layer3', 'superseded') then
    perform security.no_page_review_apply_v1(new.id, new.status, null, 'Layer 4 ' || new.status);
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.ops_guard_layer4_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
-- While a remedy runs a Layer 4 item may only stay pending or be superseded (duplicate reconciliation); approving, rejecting, returning or
-- deleting is a decision (mandate §10: technical repair authority is not admission authority).
begin
  if TG_OP = 'DELETE' or new.status not in ('pending', 'superseded') or (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' and old.status <> 'pending' and new.status is distinct from old.status) then
    raise exception 'ops guard: a remedy cannot decide or admit a Layer 4 item' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.provider_description_review_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update pipeline.provider_description_reads set
         state = case when new.status = 'rejected' then 'rejected' when new.status in ('more_evidence', 'returned_layer2', 'returned_layer3') then 'held' when new.status = 'superseded' then 'superseded' else state end,
         rule = case when new.status in ('approved', 'edited_approved') then rule else 'layer4_' || new.status end,
         updated_at = now()
   where review_item_id = new.id and state = 'proposed' and new.status not in ('approved', 'edited_approved');
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.course_description_trusted_v1(p_provider uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with n as (select greatest(1, security.pipeline_num_v1('enrich.course_description_review_first', 5)::int) k),
  d as (select r.status from pipeline.layer4_review_items r join catalogue.courses c on c.id = r.entity_id
         where r.entity_type = 'course' and r.field_code = 'course_description_first_read' and c.provider_id = p_provider
           and r.status in ('approved', 'edited_approved', 'rejected', 'more_evidence', 'returned_layer2', 'returned_layer3')
         order by r.decided_at desc nulls last limit (select k from n))
  select count(*) = (select k from n) and bool_and(d.status in ('approved', 'edited_approved')) from d
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.course_title_key(p text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select btrim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(coalesce(p, '')), '&', ' and '), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.pdesc_has_term_v1(p_text text, p_term text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.pdesc_similarity_v1(a text, b text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with x as (select security.pdesc_words_v1(a) wa, security.pdesc_words_v1(b) wb)
  select case when cardinality(x.wa) = 0 or cardinality(x.wb) = 0 then 0
              else round((select count(*) from unnest(x.wa) w where w = any (x.wb))::numeric
                         / (select count(*) from (select unnest(x.wa) union select unnest(x.wb)) u), 4) end
    from x
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.pdesc_support_v1(p_sentence text, p_quote text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with s as (select distinct left(w, 5) w from regexp_split_to_table(lower(coalesce(p_sentence, '')), '[^a-z0-9]+') w
              where length(w) >= 4 and w not in ('that', 'this', 'with', 'from', 'into', 'their', 'there', 'which', 'where', 'what', 'have', 'also', 'such', 'they', 'them', 'than', 'more', 'most', 'other', 'offers', 'offer', 'provides', 'provide')),
       q as (select distinct left(w, 5) w from regexp_split_to_table(lower(coalesce(p_quote, '')), '[^a-z0-9]+') w where length(w) >= 4)
  select case when (select count(*) from s) = 0 then 1 else round((select count(*) from s where s.w in (select w from q))::numeric / (select count(*) from s), 4) end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.pdesc_words_v1(p text)

 SET search_path TO ''

$function$
